title: Chinese Middle Class Grows Bigger Than US
paragraphs: Yang Gang viaCaixin| Chinese middle class grew bigger than that of the United States in the middle of 2015, according to an annual report by researchers at Credit Suisse Group, a leading global financial services company.

Some 664 million adults around the world are part of the middle class this year, nearly 15 percent of the world’s total adult population. Nearly 110 million of those people were Chinese, and 92 million were Americans.
